ownerApproval.scope: Implement, execute and audit the fixed one-run primary-status/auxiliary-context-event experiment; no reserved inference

scope: One local CPU research run; direct status decision with auxiliary context/event supervision; frozen v2 direct control reused. No automatic deployment or reserved evaluation.

architecture.baseCheckpoint: Pinned original pretrained encoder only; never initialize from adapted/control weights
architecture.freeze: Embeddings, encoder layers0..9 and pooler; no backbone architecture changes
architecture.headInitialization: All head weights and biases exactly zero. Dedicated batch-order RNG is independent of constructor RNG.
architecture.mode: CPU float32, entire model eval mode/dropout disabled, gradients enabled only for selected encoder tensors and heads
architecture.pooling: Published attention-mask mean pooling over final hidden states including unmasked specials,384dims; no normalization
architecture.input: Exactly original research normalize(text), pinned tokenizer, padding longest batch, max128 including specials, truncation=False; stop on overflow

cohort.encoding: Rows returned by prepare_view(): ordered original full_annotations then uncertainty_annotations, holds excluded; keys recordId,text,group,weight,status,context,event. JSON ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),UTF8,no newline.
cohort.weightRule: Recompute weight=1/nonheld record count in each source group after selecting union; same exact row weights for both arms and heads
cohort.targetRule: Three heads use unchanged status and reviewed context/event targets on the same rows; status alone decides. No source relabeling.
cohort.uncertainty: 34 nonheld original-uncertain source rows are valid three-way targets, not negative examples.17 interpretation holds excluded from both arms entirely.

training.shuffle: Dedicated CPU torch.Generator seed20261028; reproduce all3stored direct-control epoch orders before training
training.decayScope: All trainable weights and biases including LayerNorm; frozen parameters excluded
training.minibatchLoss: 1177/(129*b) * sum_i(base_group_weight_i * ((5/6)*statusCE_i+(1/12)*contextCE_i+(1/12)*eventCE_i)); unreduced per-head class-balanced CE, b actual

classReweighting.method: Fixed training-only inverse group-weighted class frequency per head:alpha_c=W/(K*mass_c); rational masses from1/group_size, W129. Same method for direct control and each factorized head.
classReweighting.implementation: Compute each alpha as frozen rational then cast float32 once; cross_entropy(weight=alpha,reduction=none); combine base row weights externally. Never weighted-mean reduction inside minibatch.
classReweighting.limits: Base group weights are identical across arms and sum1/group; class balancing intentionally changes effective per-class/per-group loss contributions differently for each task. Unknown context21.5x is supported by only8 related examples; no generalization or probability-calibration claim.

training.checkpointSelection: Exactly3epochs; final checkpoint only; training-sentinel reload check before diagnostics
training.determinism: Seed Python/NumPy/Torch; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); abort unsupported operations

decision.rule: argmax(status head) in declared order; first class wins ties

baseline.initializeCandidateFrom: Original pinned pretrained encoder only, never direct/adapted weights

evaluation.preflight: Call content_preflight on entire scored development/control set before fitting; exact declared in-sample exception only
evaluation.statusMetrics: Three-way confusion per cohort/language and uncertainty reason; uncertain is neither correct rejection nor completion; deduplicate strict benefit by raw text hash
evaluation.componentMetrics: Context/event confusion and both-field exactness only on existing32componentdev weaklabels; absent known_other/no_event truth unsupported; diagnostic only, no all-exact gate
evaluation.auxiliaryDisagreement: Report status versus old fixed context/event projection per row; never override status or describe auxiliary explanations as reliable without evidence
evaluation.references: Frozen v2 direct control primary, v2 factorized and four binary references saved outputs only; binary uncertainty unsupported

gates.definiteNontransaction: Every N -> N, including all quote controls; U is unnecessary deferral, not correct rejection
gates.uncertain: Every U -> U, separately verify outcome/frame/scope-policy reasons
gates.completed: Misses C->N/U no worse than frozen direct control AND best fixed reference in each cohort/language incl quote controls
gates.regressions: No frozen-direct-correct status case may become wrong
gates.benefit: At least one unique primary direct error fixed; no quote-only/in-sample benefit counts
gates.inSample: Known exposed control remains correct; never claim it is unseen
gates.failure: Stop, preserve evidence; no retry/refit/threshold tuning or promotion

evaluation.reserved: No reserved encoder input, annotation or scoring even if development gates pass. Existing split assembly may read source rows to preserve masks; do not construct reserved evaluation batches.

budget.deadline: Entire actual interpreter from identity handshake, includes preflight/load/train/save/reload
budget.failure: Exclusive attempt and arm ledgers before fitting; any resource/numerical failure consumes attempt; no resume/partial evaluation

outputs.checkpoint: Ignored encoder-last2+three-head delta; still requires full471MBbase

requiredChecks: Verify all frozen hashes and original view exactly
Run content guard and verify metadata-only roles/reasons before first step
Compare initial encoder hashes and stored epoch orders with frozen direct attempt; abort on mismatch, no refit of baseline
Zero all head weights/biases; verify selected parameter names/counts
Finite losses/gradients/weights, no frozen gradients; hash frozen tensors before/after
Reload base+delta and reproduce exact logits on first8training rows only
Persist intended diagnostic batch IDs before encoding; no diagnostic checkpoint selection
Independent metrics/gates/slices/checkpoint/resources audit; no reserved IDs journaled
